config.coverage_definition: Refit unconstrained and true-log-K constrained models for each generated record collection; fraction with twice-nll difference <= nominal chi-square-one cutoff. This empirically checks that cutoff with nuisance bounds, conditional on the generating model and design.
config.denominators: Retain every attempted draw, failure, retry and local-basin correction. Report coverage among complete draws, binomial Monte Carlo uncertainty and worst-case bounds counting failed draws either way.
config.expansion: No expansion to 200 until numerical convergence and the 50-draw diagnostic review justify it.
